cat > programs/task-16b52c42.py <<'EOF'
def transform(grid):
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    # Replace large uniform rectangular fields with the marked color.
    R,C=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for r0 in range(R):
        for c0 in range(C):
            v=grid[r0][c0]
            if v==4: continue
            # maximal same-color rectangle from top-left; choose broad uniform patches
            for r1 in range(r0+1,R+1):
                for c1 in range(c0+1,C+1):
                    area=(r1-r0)*(c1-c0)
                    if area<25: continue
                    if all(grid[r][c]==v for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)):
                        # only rectangles maximal in both dimensions
                        if r0>0 and all(grid[r0-1][c]==v for c in range(c0,c1)): continue
                        if c0>0 and all(grid[r][c0-1]==v for r in range(r0,r1)): continue
                        if r1<R and all(grid[r1][c]==v for c in range(c0,c1)): continue
                        if c1<C and all(grid[r][c1]==v for r in range(r0,r1)): continue
                        for r in range(r0,r1):
                            for c in range(c0,c1): out[r][c]=4
    return out
EOF
